description: Measured source visibility, independent of mesh depth profiles. Coordinates are in references/calibration.png (1907 x 1280). A silhouette is not a visibility mask: an ear, beard or sleeve can occlude a different part in the same source image. Re-measure these regions for a new character.

frontBackgroundGuard.description: Connected neutral studio backdrop only. Extend the nearest visible source pixel within the measured front interval for this same part and row; do not blur the texture or substitute a flat-colored rectangle.

Pauldron.description: Additional contour measurements around the concave gold-to-steel shoulder corner. Geometry interpolation crossed the white backdrop between sparse silhouette rows; source coordinates stay inside the visible armor.

Face · nose cheek and jaw relief.description: The shoulder hides the lower cheek/neck in profile. Continue the nearest visible beard/skin at that occlusion boundary, preserving facial landmarks in the visible region. Coordinates use the warped side image Y, not front Y.

Pauldron.description: Only the visible shoulder armor owns these source pixels. The upper front overlaps the ear/beard; the lower central opening exposes the upper arm.

Bracer.description: The front-view high bracer tip has no visible side-view counterpart above the cuff. Do not sample the sleeve there or the glove below the cuff.

Hair at rear of skull.description: The lower rear hair is hidden by the shoulder in the side reference. Extend nearby visible hair instead of projecting the golden shoulder onto the hair cap.

Face · nose cheek and jaw relief.description: Visible rear hair owns the head. The source collar must not be projected onto lower head geometry. Rows use the resized 1280 x 1907 rear source coordinates.
